name: a request with no food in it at all
note: The rules require an empty or garbage input. A request naming no food is a request nothing answers — the honest reply is that nothing matched, with whatever is genuinely worth naming. What must NOT happen is a confident `true`, which would tell somebody who typed nonsense that their results answer it.
